PORT.name: PORT
PORT.description: Port the container listens on. Railpack injects it; the entrypoint maps it to the OpenBB server's OPENBB_API_PORT.

TZ.name: TZ
TZ.description: Container timezone (IANA name), used for logs and generated output.

OPENBB_API_AUTH.name: OPENBB_API_AUTH
OPENBB_API_AUTH.description: Enable HTTP Basic auth on the API endpoints (true/false). Leave false for open access on a private project.

OPENBB_API_USERNAME.name: OPENBB_API_USERNAME
OPENBB_API_USERNAME.description: Username for the optional HTTP Basic security gate (used only when OPENBB_API_AUTH=true).

OPENBB_API_PASSWORD.name: OPENBB_API_PASSWORD
OPENBB_API_PASSWORD.description: Password for the optional HTTP Basic security gate (used only when OPENBB_API_AUTH=true). Auto-generated if you want to gate the API.

FRED_API_KEY.name: FRED_API_KEY
FRED_API_KEY.description: FRED (St. Louis Fed) API key for macro/market data. Leave blank to skip the provider.

POLYGON_API_KEY.name: POLYGON_API_KEY
POLYGON_API_KEY.description: Polygon.io API key for equity/ETF/FX market data. Leave blank to skip the provider.

ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY.name: ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY
ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY.description: Alpha Vantage API key. Leave blank to skip the provider.
